title: Accounts Administrator
description:

You will be given autonomy to do the job with no micromanagement and if capable and willing further responsibilities might come in time. - Matching and processing supplier invoices
- Supplier statement reconciliations
- Liaising with suppliers by telephone and email
- Ensuring invoices are authorised for payment
- Managing supplier queries
- Managing the purchase ledger inbox.
- Daily sales invoicing
- Liaising with customers via telephone and email.
- Credit Control including credit applications.
- Customer Statements
- Taking and allocation of customer payments
- Managing Customer queries

- Previous experience in a role which includes purchase and sales ledger responsibilities

- Excellent IT experience
- Excellent communication skills
- Organised to manage workloads

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join a well-established and growing accountancy practice in Huddersfield.

This is an ideal role for someone who is studying towards AAT and wants to gain valuable practical experience within a professional accountancy environment. You will work alongside experienced accountants and gain exposure to a broad range of client work, including accounts preparation, VAT, bookkeeping and audit. The firm is committed to supporting your professional development, with study support and training towards your AAT qualification.

What You'll Be Doing
- Assisting with the preparation of annual accounts for a range of clients
- Supporting the preparation of VAT returns
- Carrying out bookkeeping and maintaining accurate financial records
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Assisting with audit and assurance work
- Processing financial information and maintaining client records
- Assisting accountants and supervisors with ad hoc client work
- Preparing and organising financial documentation
- Supporting the team with general accountancy and administrative duties
- Dealing professionally with clients and colleagues
- Maintaining strict confidentiality when handling client information
- Following the firm's AML, compliance and internal procedures

What We're Looking For
- AAT studies underway, or a strong desire to work towards AAT
- Previous experience in an accounts, finance or office environment
- Good attention to detail and a methodical approach
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office
- The ability to handle confidential information professionally
- A willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities
- A positive, reliable and professional approach
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team

Why Join?
- AAT study and professional qualification support
- Practical experience across accounts, VAT, bookkeeping and audit
- Training and ongoing professional development

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Our client is an established brokerage business looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join their busy finance team. This is a varied, hands on role within a fast paced business.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will take responsibility for a high volume of reconciliations, ensuring financial and operational data is accurate across multiple systems. This is a high reconciliation environment, requiring someone who is confident working with a variety of systems and comfortable managing large volumes of transactions while maintaining accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
- Carry out high volume daily reconciliations, matching supplier invoices and transactional data between Dynamics 365 and Xero.
- Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies, invoice queries and coding errors.
- Support purchase ledger processes, including invoice checking, coding and exception management.
- Reconcile large batches of transactions
- Manage the release of purchase and sales invoices into Xero
- Assist with bank reconciliations, month end reporting and financial data preparation.
- Maintain accurate pricing, rebate and product information across financial systems.
- Prepare and maintain Excel reports, reconciliation workbooks and operational spreadsheets.
- Produce KPI analysis and commercial data.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous experience in a busy accounts, finance or reconciliation focused role.
- Practical working knowledge of Xero and Microsoft Dynamics 365, ideally gained in a high volume transactional environment.
- Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation and complex reconciliation spreadsheets.
- Proven experience handling large volumes of transactions and investigating discrepancies.
- Excellent attention to detail, with a methodical and organised approach to work.
- Comfortable working in a fast paced environment, managing competing priorities and meeting deadlines.
- A proactive, team focused approach, with the ability to communicate effectively with finance and non finance colleagues.
- Experience of Power BI or commercial reporting would be advantageous but is not essential.

Salary & Working Pattern
- Salary: £30,000 to £32,000 per annum
- Hours: Full time
- Working pattern: Office based
- Team: Small, close knit finance function

Why Apply?
The position offers a good mix of transactional accounting, complex reconciliations and commercial reporting, with exposure to different areas of the business. You will work closely with an experienced Finance Manager and have the opportunity to broaden your systems knowledge and reporting experience.
The role would particularly suit someone who enjoys detailed reconciliation work, thrives in a busy finance environment and values being part of a supportive, hands on team.

IPS Finance has 45 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long term relationships with both individuals and clients in all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. Please visit our website to view the latest accountancy / finance and practice opportunities.

title: Accounts Assistant - Practice
description:
Accounts Assistant

Huddersfield

Competitive Salary + Benefits

About the Company

W Talent Finance is a specialist recruitment partner dedicated to placing high-calibre accounting professionals across both practice and commerce & industry markets worldwide. With a deep understanding of the finance landscape, we support clients ranging from leading professional services firms to established regional practices and multi-service professional groups, delivering tailored talent solutions that drive business performance.

We are partnering with a well-established, multi-service accountancy and professional services firm with a strong regional presence and an excellent reputation for delivering trusted advice to businesses and individuals.

With over 220 employees across 11 offices throughout Yorkshire and Derbyshire, the business provides a comprehensive range of professional services, including accountancy, financial services, corporate finance and wider business advisory support.

The organisation promotes a people-focused environment built around collaboration, professionalism and integrity. It places strong emphasis on creating a supportive and inclusive culture where individuals are encouraged to develop their skills, take ownership of their work and progress within an established and approachable team.

The Role

As an Accounts Assistant, you will join an established accountancy practice, providing a combination of accounting and administrative support to the wider accounts team.

You will assist with the preparation of annual accounts, bookkeeping, VAT returns, bank reconciliations and other accounting duties, gaining exposure to a broad range of services provided to the firm's clients. Alongside your day-to-day responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge and practical experience while working towards an AAT apprenticeship.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career within accountancy, develop a strong foundation of accounting skills and gain valuable experience within a reputable professional services environment. The role offers structured learning, professional study support and the opportunity to develop under the guidance of experienced colleagues.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the preparation of annual accounts for a varied client base
- Undertake bookkeeping duties, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date
- Assist with the preparation of VAT returns and supporting documentation
- Complete bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies where required
- Support the accounts team with a range of accounting functions and financial reporting activities
- Develop an understanding of the processes involved in preparing a full set of financial accounts
- Provide administrative support to colleagues, supervisors and managers across the practice
- Follow instructions from supervisors and managers, seeking guidance where necessary
- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure client information is handled confidentially
- Assist with the organisation, filing, archiving and maintenance of client documentation
- Manage incoming and outgoing post and provide general office administration support
- Answer incoming telephone calls professionally and direct enquiries to the appropriate colleagues
- Respond to colleagues and clients in a courteous and professional manner
- Follow relevant policies, procedures and money laundering regulations
- Participate in training and development activities, including working towards the AAT apprenticeship
- Support the wider team in meeting client deadlines and achieving business objectives
- Undertake additional accounting and administrative duties as required

About You
- An interest in accountancy and a genuine desire to build a career within an accountancy practice
- Studying towards AAT, or keen to undertake an AAT apprenticeship
- Previous experience in an accounts or administrative role would be advantageous but is not essential, depending on the candidate's overall suitability
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing tasks
- Excellent time management skills and a willingness to learn
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A professional and confident telephone manner
- Good IT skills, with the ability to learn accounting software and other systems
- Strong record-keeping skills and a methodical approach to work
- The ability to follow instructions and work effectively under the guidance of experienced colleagues
- A proactive attitude with a willingness to take responsibility and develop new skills
- The ability to handle confidential financial and client information appropriately
- A professional, courteous and team-focused approach
- Commitment to ongoing learning, professional development and completing relevant training

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days
- Pension scheme
- Health Cash Plan (Level 1)
- Life assurance at 4x salary
- Eye test support
- AAT apprenticeship and professional study support
- Ongoing training, development and opportunities to build a career within accountancy
- Social events and staff engagement activities
- Volunteering opportunities
- Staff discounts on wills, lasting powers of attorney and residential mortgages
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a broad range of accounting services
- The chance to learn from experienced accounting professionals and develop long-term career prospects

title: Administrator
description:
Empowering Every Learner, Inspiring Every Day

Job Title: School Office Administrator
Location: Huddersfield Grammar, Luck Lane, Huddersfield, HD1 4 QX
Salary: £13,562.22 per annum
Hours: 25 hours per week Monday to Friday 8.00am - 1.00pm
Contract: Permanent Term Time Only
Start: November 2026

UK applicants only. This role does not offer sponsorship.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a highly organised and professional Administrator to play a key role in supporting the smooth day-to-day running of our school. As one of the first points of contact for students, parents, staff and visitors, you will provide a welcoming and efficient administrative service while ensuring school systems, communications and procedures operate effectively.

This is a varied and rewarding role that combines front-of-house responsibilities with wider administrative support across the school. You will coordinate communications, maintain records and calendars, support the organisation of trips and events, manage payment systems, and contribute to student wellbeing through first aid and medication administration.

Key responsibilities include:
- Providing a professional and welcoming reception service, acting as a key point of contact for visitors, parents, students and staff.
- Managing telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries, ensuring information is handled efficiently and sensitively.
- Preparing and distributing clear and accurate communications to parents, carers and staff.
- Maintaining the school calendar, ensuring events, meetings, trips and key dates are accurately recorded and communicated.
- Supporting the planning and administration of educational visits, school trips and off-site activities.
- Managing bookings, payments and reporting through ParentPay and other school systems.
- Assisting with the organisation of school events, clubs, parents' evenings and other activities.
- Maintaining accurate student records and databases, ensuring information is kept up to date and handled confidentially.

This role would suit an organised, proactive and approachable individual who enjoys working in a busy school environment and takes pride in delivering an excellent service to students, families and colleagues.

About You

We are looking for a professional, organised and proactive administrator who thrives in a busy environment and takes pride in delivering excellent support to colleagues, students and families. You will be able to manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders and maintain high levels of accuracy and confidentiality at all times.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- GCSE English and Mathematics at Grade 4/C or above (or equivalent qualifications).
- Experience working in a busy administrative or office-based environment.
- The ability to manage a varied workload, prioritise tasks effectively and remain calm when dealing with changing demands and interruptions.
- Experience maintaining accurate records and handling sensitive or confidential information with discretion.
- Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.

Most importantly, you will be a dependable team player with a positive, flexible approach and a commitment to supporting the smooth and successful operation of the school.

About Blenheim Schools

Blenheim Schools is a growing family of innovative, high-quality independent schools committed to enabling outstanding futures for every student. Our ethos centres on truly understanding each child, their talents, character and aspirations by providing a personalised, ambitious education that helps every child to thrive.

We deliver a broad, enriching curriculum supported by tailored teaching and exceptional pastoral care. We celebrate individuality, nurture confidence and champion every learner so they can discover their strengths and achieve their potential.

Joining Blenheim Schools means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking community that values creativity, inclusion and professional growth. Our teams are united by a shared belief in the power of education to transform lives and by a commitment to delivering outstanding experiences for students and families.

We are proud to be part of OFG Education, which in 2025 was officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the sixth consecutive year.

How to Apply

Complete this application before the closing date.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

OFG Education is committed to carrying out a fair, thorough and efficient recruitment process in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education. Whilst we aim to keep applicants informed throughout, OFG Education does not accept liability for any loss of earnings or other associated costs incurred by applicants as a result of delays or changes in the compliance process. All stages of the compliance process are subject to necessary safeguarding checks and compliance with statutory requirements, which may affect timescales.

title: Customer Specialist Sales Administrator B2B
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION, PROFILE AND SCOPE OF ROLE:

Our client is an established, world-leading manufacturing and engineered solutions business, backed by strong and sustained investment in capital, plant, and people. Operating as part of a prestigious international group, they supply specialist industrial solutions to blue-chip global clients across multiple engineering sectors.

Due to business expansion, they are seeking to appoint an interim Customer Service & Customs Specialist based at their Huddersfield facility. The role will initially run for a minimum of 12 months, with potential long-term prospects.

The successful candidate will provide critical B2 B customer support, manage the end-to-end UK import/customs declaration process, and oversee customer digital procurement portals. You will act as a pivotal operational link between UK clients, international distributor networks, and central European group headquarters.

NB: This role will initially last for twelve months, and may become permanent.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
- B2 B Order & Account Administration: Execute the full customer order lifecycle in SAP handling customer order entry, price verification, credit checks, order confirmations, delivery notes, invoicing, and sample requests.
- Customer Inquiry & Account Liaison: Act as a key point of contact for corporate customers, distributors, and external sales engineers; field phone and email inquiries, provide order status updates, and ensure high levels of service delivery.
- Customer Portals & Digital Interface: Administer digital customer procurement platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba) and partner portals, managing distributor onboarding, product documentation, and inspection certificates.
- Customer Issue Resolution & Billing Support: Support customer account management by resolving price discrepancies, handling invoice queries, assisting with dunning, and maintaining accurate customer master data in SAP.
- Customs & Import Compliance: Oversee UK import declarations (EU/international), HS code classification, duty calculations, and Northern Ireland TSS portal submissions to ensure seamless order delivery to UK customers.
- HMRC & Internal Stakeholder Liaison: Manage import VAT/duty deferment accounts with Finance, liaise with HMRC/brokers to resolve shipping holds, collaborate with European HQ compliance teams, and maintain 4-year audit-ready records.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES:

ESSENTIAL
- Proven experience in an Order Management, Sales Administration, or Customer Support role within a commercial or office environment.
- Hands-on proficiency with ERP order management systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Sage, or similar).
- Strong administrative aptitude, attention to detail, and confidence learning digital systems and customer portals.
- Excellent internal communication skills, team-player attitude, and a strong work ethic with a willingness to deliver results.

ADVANTAGEOUS NOT ESSENTIAL
- Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, distribution, or B2 B technical sector.
- Prior operational experience using SAP or SAP Ariba specifically.
- Basic exposure to UK customs/import administration, HS code classification, or Trader Support Services (TSS) for Northern Ireland declarations (full training provided).
- Formal qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or an equivalent discipline.

ADDITONAL
- The role will likely require occasional travel to the company s European HQ, so prospective candidates must hold a full UK passport and have no restrictions on travel to the EU.

Competative Salary Commensurate with Experience + Competitive Benefits

NB1: This is a temporary role, and will last a minimum of twelve months (it may become permanent, but no undertaking can be made to this effect).

NB2: The role is an onsite/office-based position based in Huddersfield.

NB3: The Agency acts as an introducer, and if successful you will be paid directly by the company engaging you and not by the Agency.

title: Fleet Operations Account Coordinator
description:
Fleet Operations Account Coordinator

Franchised Motor Dealership - Huddersfield

Are you an automotive experienced, customer service professional with strong organisational skills and a passion for building lasting customer relationships?

We're looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Fleet Operations Account Coordinator to join a busy Business Centre team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with motor trade experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys coordinating orders and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Logistics Coordinator

Location: Huddersfield

Hours: Monday to Friday, fully office based

Salary: £30,000 £35,000 DOE

Are you an organised and customer-focused planner who thrives in a fast-paced environment?

We are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to join a busy, collaborative planning team. This is a key role responsible for coordinating customer orders and planning deliveries to ensure excellent levels of service while maximising resource and vehicle utilisation.

You will need to be solution-focused, calm under pressure and highly organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work collaboratively with customers, drivers, resource teams and internal stakeholders.

About the role:

Key responsibilities will include:

- Liaise with customers, resource teams and control teams to effectively match supply with demand.
- Monitor and replan deliveries where required, maximising driver and vehicle utilisation.
- Ensure customer-specific requirements, delivery instructions and equipment requirements are met.
- Identify and escalate potential delivery issues, low-stock situations and service risks, providing practical solutions.
- Plan resources cost-effectively while ensuring safe, compliant vehicle loading and operational standards.
- Maintain accurate records, volumes and management information while supporting customer service and operational KPIs.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Strong organisational, time-management and attention-to-detail skills.
- Solution-focused with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Calm and effective under pressure, with the ability to manage changing priorities.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to accurately interpret data.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Collaborative team player who can work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience in logistics, transport, planning or a similar operational environment is beneficial; knowledge of working time and tachograph legislation is advantageous.

What's on Offer?
- Fast-paced and customer-focused working environment
- Opportunity to join a collaborative and supportive team
- Varied role with responsibility for national planning and customer accounts
- Opportunity to develop your planning and logistics career

If you're an organised, resilient and customer-focused Logistics Coordinator who enjoys solving problems and working as part of a team, we'd be keen to hear from you!

title: Markets Customer Service Assistant

title: Quality Administrator

title: Veterinary Insurance Administrator
description:
Job Title: Veterinary Insurance Administrator

Location: Huddersfield

Salary: 15.50 - 15.92 per hr, depending on experience qualifications and skills

Job Type: Part Time, Permanent

Hours: 30 hours per week, Mon, Tues, Thur and Fri, 9am-5pm or 10am-6pm

Holidays: 31 days including stats (pro rata), increasing to 34 days with service (pro rata)

About Donaldson's Vets:

Donaldson's Vets Ltd is an independently owned veterinary group with seven practices across Huddersfield, including our own veterinary hospital.

We are passionate about providing exceptional care for animals and pride ourselves on delivering 'Total Care' for pets. We combine cutting-edge training, facilities, equipment and premises with traditional, personal care.

The Role:

We are looking for a Registered Veterinary Nurse to join our established team. This is a key role in supporting the smooth and efficient administration of insurance claims across our practices. Working closely with clients, insurance companies and colleagues, helping to ensure claims are processed accurately, accounts are reconciled promptly and our clients receive a professional and supportive service.

We need someone who can take ownership of their workload, use initiative and be a valued member of our friendly and forward-thinking team.

Ideally, you will be a qualified RVN with experience in veterinary insurance administration and a good understanding of insurance claims processes.

You will have excellent organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail whilst maintaining a professional and positive approach in a busy working environment.

If you have experience in a similar role, together with drive, enthusiasm and a commitment to delivering high standards, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing and submitting insurance claims to insurance companies using multiple platforms, including Pawtal and VetEnvoy.
- Monitoring and responding to emails, messages, telephone enquiries from clients, insurers and colleagues.
- Reconciling client accounts against paid insurance claims, ensuring accounts are accurately balanced and clinical and financial records are updated.
- Producing and issuing insurance debt letters.
- Liaising with the Debt Control team regarding outstanding balances.
- Supporting and assisting and providing cover for members of the team
- Supporting the ongoing training of practice staff with insurance processes.
- Creating and maintaining insurance training materials
- Maintaining and developing your professional knowledge through CPD.
- Undertaking any training required to support you effectively in your role.

About You:

Essential Experience & Skills:

We are looking for someone who has:
- Proven experience in a similar role, ideally within a veterinary environment.
- Experience using veterinary practice management software, preferably Merlin or similar.
- Ability to manage your own workload, prioritise effectively, use initiative to find practical solutions for both clients and the business.
- Experience using Microsoft Excel and Word.
- Experience using Google Docs an advantage.
- Excellent attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The confidence and ability to manage challenging customer conversations professionally.
- Patience and the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
- Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
- The ability to adapt quickly, make effective and timely decisions, and respond positively to change.
- A strong focus on achieving targets and meeting deadlines.

Personal Qualities:

We operate in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, so you will need to be:
- Friendly, approachable and professional.
- Highly organised, reliable and attentive to detail.
- Flexible and adaptable, responding positively to changing priorities.
- Proactive, solutions-focused, confident to take ownership, use initiative, find effective solutions
- Accountable for your own work and committed to delivering high standards.
- A supportive team player who enjoys working collaboratively.
- Calm, patient professional when dealing with challenging situations.
- Committed to providing a high-quality service to all

Benefits:

In addition to a competitive salary, our benefits include:
- 31 days' holiday, including stats (pro rata), increasing to 34 days with service (pro rata).
- Pension scheme.
- Company sick pay scheme.
- Staff discount scheme.
- Enhanced maternity pay.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Ongoing training and CPD

How to Apply:

If you are an experienced Insurance Administrator looking for an opportunity to join an established and forward-thinking veterinary group, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV together with a covering letter outlining:
- Your relevant experience and skills.
- Your salary expectations.
- Your availability to commence employment.

All candidates must currently have the right to live and work in the United Kingdom.

Please Note:

Bluetownonline are advertising this role on behalf of the company Donaldson's Vets.

Please click the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with the experience and relevant job titles of: Veterinary Insurance Administrator, Registered Veterinary Nurse / RVN, Pet Insurance Claims Administrator, Veterinary Claims Administrator, Vet Practice Administrator, Insurance Claims Handler, Veterinary Receptionist / Administrator may also be considered for this role.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Medical Receptionist 2 x 20 hours per week or 1 x 37.5 hours to provide temporary maternity cover within our friendly and supportive practice. You will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. This is a front-line role, ideal for someone who is professional, approachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment. The position can be offered as one full-time post or shared between two part-time staff, depending on availability and suitability. Receiving calls and assisting with direct face to face patient enquiries are predominant parts of this role, therefore this will be very suited to people with previous customer facing roles. Day to day varies from booking appointments, processing medication requests, dealing with patients who want to register at the practice and dealing with general enquiries, signposting them to the most appropriate appointment or service. Good communication skills are vital for the role and basic IT skills will be needed. Job Summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive, friendly and courteous image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Process repeat prescription requests from patients. Scan in correspondence to the clinical database and workflow to the GPs. Job Responsibilities: Be familiar with the Practice computer and be able to input data as required. To have knowledge of the Practice area/boundary. To know under which circumstances clinical and non-clinical advice should be sought. Handle incoming and outgoing telephone calls in a polite and efficient manner. Ensure all messages are passed to the appropriate team member, and colleagues made aware of any action required. Be able to cover all reception positions as necessary. Provide additional cover for the reception office during periods of holiday or sickness. Reception Receiving patients consulting with members of practice team. Keep reception areas tidy at all times. Accepting requests for repeat prescriptions, checking the fax and prescription box for repeat prescription requests Handover to incoming staff patient information on any issues not yet completed. To deal with visitors and tradesmen appropriately. To ensure the timely notification of all deliveries to the relevant staff. Administration Pulling/filing medical records and update as necessary. Download and file electronic patient correspondence received in medical records. Photocopy and laminate documents as requested. Scanning duties Sort and date stamp all incoming patient-related mail. Scan patient-related documents onto their medical record using read codes as agreed by the clinical team Add any additional information about the source of the document Forward the document to the doctor or nurse who initiated the referral or who is most appropriate to receive the information Ensure incoming letters are scanned onto the patient record within a 48/72-hour timescale Scan all internal paper documents on to the relevant patients record and then store the documents in line with surgery procedures. Coding Identify relevant clinical information contained in patient correspondence Code or free text the clinical information on to the patient record Deal with queries relating to coding Appointments Process appointment requests for today and future appointments from patients by telephone and in person. Deal with visit requests and produce any documentation required for the doctors. Arrange and record hospital transport requests. Computer Carry out data input, ensuring that the recording of all relevant information into the patients electronic medical record is accurate and concise. Registration of new patients computer data entry and medical records. Process patients change of address computer data and medical records. Process applications from patients for online Patient Access. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines. Telephone Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours. Other Tasks Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm. Open up premises at the start of the day if the first to arrive and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. Make refreshments (tea/coffee) for doctors and colleagues. Any other tasks allocated by the Partners or Practice Manager. Confidentiality : In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & Safety : The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards. Reporting potential risks identified. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Equality and Diversity : The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation. Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues. Behaving in a manner, which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development : Mandatory training courses, i.e. fire safety, safeguarding, CPR etc. Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality : The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs. Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication : The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members, patients and carers. Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the Implementation of Services : The post-holder will: Work in accordance with practice policies, standards and guidance. Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work. Make use of information technology systems available within the Practice, following systems for data security and protection. Participate in audit where appropriate. Attend and participate in practice meetings/training events. Any other duties commensurate with the role to ensure the smooth running of the Practice. This job description may need to be reviewed as the Practice develops.
